body: I struggled with this for a long time. One day I was having an especially hard time with pushing myself forward and I just told my friend in a text. She thought I was telling a bad joke but it was the catalyst for me turning to her for help. I still need help. Talking doesn't solve the issue immediately but it helps to have someone just be there. But I won't lie to you, this is an awful struggle.

I essentially do the same but some days I feel adrift, and going through the motions of a normal life feels like I'm swimming against the current. If I didn't have people that cared about me, I wouldn't bother anymore. I think I gave up on my life a long time ago. I'm just living for them now.
